new.s: The term 'Fourth Industrial Revolution' was coined by:
o: Klaus Schwab of the World Economic Forum in 2016
new.x: Klaus Schwab, founder of the World Economic Forum (WEF), coined the term in 2016. Toffler wrote of the 'Third Wave', Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web, and Nilekani led UIDAI; none coined 4IR.

new.s: The World Economic Forum's Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution (C4IR) announced for Andhra Pradesh is India's:
o: Fourth, after Mumbai, Telangana and Karnataka
new.x: The WEF C4IR centre in Andhra Pradesh is India's third, after Mumbai and Telangana. So it is neither the first nor the second, and no fourth (Karnataka) centre precedes it in the notes.

new.s: The defining feature of the Internet of Things (IoT) is that:
o: Devices are networked to communicate without human intervention
Every device must be operated manually by a human user
Data is transmitted only through LEDs
All devices must be connected through a single blockchain ledger
new.x: IoT devices are networked to communicate with each other without human intervention. Manual operation is the opposite of IoT; data through LEDs describes Li-Fi; a blockchain ledger is DLT, not a defining feature of IoT.
new.tq: IoT = machines talking to machines, no human needed.
